name: ADELANTO
description: Pesos ya, sin vender tus dólares. Un agente cuida tu préstamo. — Pesos now, without selling your dollars. Argentine banks charge 64.63% a year for a personal loan (BCRA, 2 Nov 2026); ADELANTO lends Ripio wARS on Celo against USDT at 22% a year when the pool is idle and 36% at 80% use, with a 0.25% opening fee. The borrower keeps their dollars. Lenders earn the interest on their wARS. The borrower sets the agent's limits once, from a rule in their own words, and the LoanGuard contract on Celo enforces them: the agent can only add the borrower's own dollars, repay with the borrower's own pesos, and act inside the signed daily caps. Every loan writes a public credit record on chain. Other agents buy the peso rate, a borrow quote or a wallet's credit record over x402, paying in wARS or USD₮ through Celo's facilitator. For bigger loans the agent quotes Morpho on Ethereum through a proxy that runs only orders the borrower signed.
